title: Playtesters asked about human sacrifice in Pelota. Here’s what losing a tournament match looks like.
author: Wide-Bobcat-3723
selftext:
You can play the alpha free right now at [https://pelota.io](https://pelota.io)

I’m making Pelota, a sports game inspired by the Mesoamerican ballgame. This clip shows the darker side of the story: what happens to the defeated players in one of Chapter 2’s tournaments.   


\*contains graphic in-game violence and blood.

The current alpha supports:

* Controllers
* Online co-op with a friend
* Local couch co-op

I’d  love feedback on how the game feels with a controller and how co-op plays.

The full game is coming to Steam soon. For now, jump into the alpha and let me know what you think!
